sidebar.showingChannels: Showing {limit} of {total} channels. Use filters to narrow results.

server.title: Server Settings
server.listDelayDescription: Time to wait after connecting before requesting the channel list. Some servers require a minimum wait.
server.listRefreshDescription: How often to re-request the channel list. Set to 0 to disable.
server.keepaliveDescription: Proactively ping the server to detect dead connections. Recommended for background tabs.
server.keepaliveIntervalDescription: Seconds of inactivity before sending a PING.
server.autoReconnectDescription: Automatically reconnect with exponential backoff (up to 5 attempts).
server.overrideIdentity: Override identity for this server. Leave fields empty to use your global settings.
server.usernameNote: Only takes effect on next connection.
server.realnameNote: Visible in WHOIS. Only takes effect on next connection.
server.mircDescription: mIRC formatting uses control characters for bold, italic, colors, etc. When set to Auto, formatting will be enabled if the server sends formatted content.
server.mircSupportedList2: Foreground and background colors (16 standard + 83 extended)
server.hiddenPreviewsDescription: Messages from these users show links but no image previews.
server.blockedUsersDescription: Messages from blocked users are hidden and DM attempts are ignored.
server.userRestrictions: User restrictions on this server. Entries are automatically removed after 24 hours.
server.filteredMessages: Messages containing any of these texts will be hidden in public channels. Case-insensitive substring match.
server.forgetServerConfirmTitle: Click again to confirm — this will erase user identity for this server
server.forgetServerTitle: Clear nickname, username and realname overrides for this server
server.accountDescription: Enter your NickServ credentials to authenticate automatically on connect. Uses SASL if the server supports it, otherwise NickServ IDENTIFY.
server.credentialsNotice: Credentials are stored locally in your browser.

global.title: Global Settings
global.subtitle: Your IRC identity
global.clearOnCloseDescription: When enabled, messages, user lists and topics are removed from memory when you close a channel or conversation. Disable to keep history until the page is reloaded.
global.nicknameDescription: Your display name on IRC servers. Leave empty for a random name.
global.usernameDescription: Sent during registration. Only takes effect on next connection.
global.realnameDescription: Visible in WHOIS. Only takes effect on next connection.
global.nickservDescription: Automatic identification with NickServ will be available in a future update.
global.imageUploads: Configure your own API keys for image hosting services. Your keys are stored locally in your browser and never sent to our servers.
global.forgetMeConfirmTitle: Click again to confirm — this will erase all your settings
global.forgetMeTitle: Erase all user data and server settings from this browser
